examples.chinese: 他找你多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Tā zhǎo nǐ duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much change did he give you?

examples.chinese: 這些東西一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē dōngxi yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do these things cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 請給我們一杯紅茶、一杯綠茶。請問一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng gěi wǒmen yì bēi hóngchá, yì bēi lǜchá. Qǐngwèn yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: We would to have a cup of black tea and a cup of green tea. How much does that cost altogether?

examples.chinese: 這個蛋糕跟這瓶果汁一共多少錢？
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge dàngāo gēn zhè píng guǒzhī yígòng duōshǎo qián?
examples.english: How much do this cake and this bottle of juice cost?

items.wordHook: a 小(small) child pinches a grain of rice → 少(little).

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我把剛買回來的小說擺在書架上。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"準備吃飯了，快點兒把碗筷擺好！","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ gāng mǎi huílái de xiǎoshuō bǎi zài shūjià shàng. Zhǔnbèi chīfàn le, kuài diǎnr bǎ wǎnkuài bǎi hǎo!
examples.english: I placed the novel I just bought on the bookshelf. We're getting ready to eat; quickly set out the bowls and chopsticks!

examples.chinese: 王先生跟女朋友吵了一架，現在兩個人不說話了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng xiānsheng gēn nǚpéngyou chǎo le yì jià, xiànzài liǎng ge rén bù shuōhuà le.
examples.english: Mr. Wang had an argument with his girlfriend; now the two of them are not speaking to each other.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese: 小朋友！別吵架、別打架了，有話好好地說。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎopéngyou! Bié chǎojià, bié dǎjià le, yǒu huà hǎohǎo de shuō.
examples.english: Kids! Stop arguing and stop fighting; if you have something to say, say it nicely.

examples.chinese: 我和姊姊小時候常為了搶玩具吵個沒完，有時候還打架呢。那場演唱會請到了大家最喜愛的明星，所以門票很快就被搶光了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé jiějie xiǎoshíhòu cháng wèile qiǎng wánjù chǎo gè méiwán, yǒu shíhòu hái dǎjià ne. Nà chǎng yǎnchànghuì qǐng dào le dàjiā zuì xǐ'ài de míngxīng, suǒyǐ ménpiào hěn kuài jiù bèi qiǎng guāng le.
examples.english: When my older sister and I were little, we often argued endlessly over competing for toys, and sometimes we even fought. That concert invited everyone's favorite star, so the tickets were quickly snatched up.

examples.chinese: 我昨天親眼看到小史跟人吵架，才知道他罵人的樣子好可怕喔！
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zuótiān qīnyǎn kàndào Xiǎo Shǐ gēn rén chǎojià, cái zhīdào tā mà rén de yàngzi hǎo kěpà o!
examples.english: Yesterday I saw with my own eyes Xiao Shi arguing with someone, and only then did I realize how scary he looks when he scolds people!

examples.chinese: 小連跟老闆吵架而離開了公司，為了讓家人能繼續過安定的生活，他正努力地找新工作。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Lián gēn lǎobǎn chǎojià ér líkāi le gōngsī, wèile ràng jiārén néng jìxù guò āndìng de shēnghuó, tā zhèng nǔlì de zhǎo xīn gōngzuò.
examples.english: Xiao Lian left the company after quarreling with the boss; in order to let his family continue to live a safe and stable life, he is working hard to find a new job.

examples.chinese: 張先生夫婦自從結婚以來，不曾吵過架，因為兩人的脾氣都太好了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng fūfù zìcóng jiéhūn yǐlái, bùcéng chǎo guò jià, yīnwèi liǎng rén de píqi dōu tài hǎo le.
examples.english: Since Mr. and Mrs. Zhang got married, they have never had a fight, because both of their tempers are too good.

examples.chinese: 前幾天他們因為一點兒小誤會吵了一架，還好現在和好了。
有些事忍耐一下就過去了，什麼都想以吵架的方式解決，遲早會出事的。
擁有一架小飛機並親自在天空上駕駛，一直是孫小姐的夢想。
華語書籍陳列在書架的左邊，如有興趣可隨意翻翻。

items.wordHook: You 加(add) a wing to 朩(split wood) and count one 架(measure word for airplanes).

examples.chinese: 下班以後，我常跟同事一起去吃晚飯。
examples.pinyin: Xiàbān yǐhòu, wǒ cháng gēn tóngshì yìqǐ qù chī wǎnfàn.
examples.english: After getting off work, I often go to eat dinner with colleagues.

examples.chinese: 我同事說那家店的麵包很好吃，大人、小孩都喜歡，很受歡迎。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ tóngshì shuō nà jiā diàn de miànbāo hěn hǎochī, dàrén, xiǎohái dōu xǐhuān, hěn shòu huānyíng.
examples.english: My colleague says that bakery's bread is very delicious; both adults and children like it—it's very popular.

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"我剛去工作的時候，常常需要同事的幫助。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"幫助別人讓我覺得很快樂！","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gāng qù gōngzuò de shíhou, chángcháng xūyào tóngshì de bāngzhù. Bāngzhù biérén ràng wǒ juéde hěn kuàilè!
examples.english: When I first started working, I often needed my colleagues' help. Helping others makes me feel very happy!

examples.chinese: [{"chinese":"同事都走了，只剩下他一個人還在做事。","pinyin":"","english":""},{"chinese":"他是廣告公司的經理，每天要做好多事，忙得不得了。","pinyin":"","english":""}]
examples.pinyin: Tóngshì dōu zǒu le, zhǐ shèngxià tā yí ge rén hái zài zuòshì. Tā shì guǎnggào gōngsī de jīnglǐ, měitiān yào zuò hǎo duō shì, máng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: The colleagues have all left; only he is left still working. He is a manager at an advertising company; every day he has to do a lot of work and is incredibly busy.

examples.chinese: 我很餓，同事把他的薯條分一半給我，讓我好感動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hěn è, tóngshì bǎ tā de shǔtiáo fēn yí bàn gěi wǒ, ràng wǒ hǎo gǎndòng.
examples.english: I was very hungry, and my colleague shared half of his fries with me, which really moved me.

examples.chinese: 我在車站遇到以前的同事，他現在是一家保險公司的經理。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zài chēzhàn yùdào yǐqián de tóngshì, tā xiànzài shì yì jiā bǎoxiǎn gōngsī de jīnglǐ.
examples.english: I ran into a former colleague at the station; he is now a manager at an insurance company.

examples.chinese: 東賢演什麼像什麼，每部戲都演得非常好，觀眾對他的表現非常肯定。我的新同事不但工作能力強， 也很負責，來公司沒多久就得到經理的肯定。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxián yǎn shénme xiàng shénme, měi bù xì dōu yǎn de fēicháng hǎo, guānzhòng duì tā de biǎoxiàn fēicháng kěndìng. Wǒ de xīn tóngshì bùdàn gōngzuò nénglì qiáng, yě hěn fùzé, lái gōngsī méi duōjiǔ jiù dédào jīnglǐ de kěndìng.
examples.english: Dongxian acts whatever role and becomes it; he performs very well in every drama, and the audience highly approves of his performance. My new colleague not only has strong work ability but is also very responsible; not long after coming to the company, he gained the manager's approval.

examples.chinese: A:謝謝你的幫助。沒有你的話， 我一個人很難完成新產品的廣告設計。 B:別這麼說。我們是同事，互相幫助是應該的。
examples.pinyin: A: Xièxie nǐ de bāngzhù. Méiyǒu nǐ de huà, wǒ yīge rén hěn nán wánchéng xīn chǎnpǐn de guǎnggào shèjì. B: Bié zhème shuō. Wǒmen shì tóngshì, hùxiāng bāngzhù shì yīnggāi de.
examples.english: A: Thank you for your help. Without you, it would be very difficult for me to complete the advertising design for the new product alone. B: Don't say that. We are colleagues; helping each other is only right.

examples.chinese: 為了參加同事的婚禮，我打算當天穿上很有特色的中國傳統服裝。
examples.pinyin: Wèile cānjiā tóngshì de hūnlǐ, wǒ dǎsuàn dāngtiān chuān shàng hěn yǒu tèsè de Zhōngguó chuántǒng fúzhuāng.
examples.english: In order to attend my colleague's wedding, I plan to wear very distinctive traditional Chinese clothing on that day.

examples.chinese: 就要開會了，可是我同事還沒把新產品的說明資料準備好，真叫人緊張。
examples.pinyin: Jiù yào kāihuì le, kěshì wǒ tóngshì hái méi bǎ xīn chǎnpǐn de shuōmíng zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, zhēn jiào rén jǐnzhāng.
examples.english: The meeting is about to start, but my colleague still hasn't prepared the explanatory materials for the new product, which really makes one nervous.

examples.chinese: 在所有的同事中，我覺得小周最好相處了。他的性格開朗、說話幽默，還常主動幫忙，跟他相處起來很愉快、很自在。
examples.pinyin: Zài suǒyǒu de tóngshì zhōng, wǒ juéde Xiǎo Zhōu zuì hǎo xiāngchǔ le. Tā de xìnggé kāilǎng, shuōhuà yōumò, hái cháng zhǔdòng bāngmáng, gēn tā xiāngchǔ qǐlái hěn yúkuài, hěn zìzài.
examples.english: Among all my colleagues, I think Xiao Zhou is the easiest to get along with. He has a cheerful personality, speaks humorously, and often offers help proactively; getting along with him is very pleasant and relaxed.

examples.chinese: 雖然藍先生是大學的校長，可是他很謙虛，經常向同事請教管理學校的方法。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Lán xiānsheng shì dàxué de xiàozhǎng, kěshì tā hěn qiānxū, jīngcháng xiàng tóngshì qǐngjiào guǎnlǐ xuéxiào de fāngfǎ.
examples.english: Although Mr. Lan is a university president, he is very modest and often asks colleagues for advice on methods for managing the school.

examples.chinese: 如果同事之間不願意溝通，這個會議怎麼開下去呢？
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ tóngshì zhījiān bú yuànyì gōutōng, zhège huìyì zěnme kāi xiàqù ne?
examples.english: If colleagues are unwilling to communicate with each other, how can this meeting continue?

examples.chinese: 我已經退休了，不過還時常跟幾位要好的同事通信。
小張的個性比較懶，很少主動幫同事的忙。
同事搬新家，我們送他一組茶具，恭喜他吧。
公司的午餐時間很短，因此同事們總是吃得很趕。
那項新產品的設計圖你一個人負責太辛苦了，倒不如找同事一起來做。
我的同事遲到的次數太多了，這個月被扣了半個月的薪水。
公司上頭要求小張一個人完成任務，同事們都認為有點兒勉強。
我同事下個月總算要和交往十年的女朋友結婚了，真是不容易啊！。
老方住院開刀時，同事們都輪流到醫院慰問並照顧他。
公司來了位新同事，老闆要我向他一一介紹公司的規定。
這次活動是公司主辦的，目的是為了增加同事之間的感情。

items.wordHook: 同(same) + 事(affair) → people who share the same work affairs: colleague.

examples.chinese: 來台灣以後，我認識了很多國家的新朋友。
examples.pinyin: Lái Táiwān yǐhòu, wǒ rènshi le hěn duō guójiā de xīn péngyǒu.
examples.english: After coming to Taiwan, I have met many new friends from many countries.

examples.chinese: 在外國跟在自己國家的生活一定不太一樣。
examples.pinyin: Zài wàiguó gēn zài zìjǐ guójiā de shēnghuó yídìng bú tài yíyàng.
examples.english: Living in a foreign country and living in your own country are definitely not quite the same.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 每個國家都有偉大的人物，值得大家紀念他們。
examples.pinyin: Měi ge guójiā dōu yǒu wěidà de rénwù, zhídé dàjiā jìniàn tāmen.
examples.english: Every country has great figures who are worth everyone commemorating.

examples.chinese: 他年輕時曾經去過很多國家旅遊，現在老了，沒體力出國了。
examples.pinyin: Tā niánqīng shí céngjīng qùguo hěn duō guójiā lǚyóu, xiànzài lǎo le, méi tǐlì chūguó le.
examples.english: When he was young, he once traveled to many countries; now he is old and doesn't have the energy to go abroad.

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 孔子希望君王能夠接受他的建議來管理國家。
examples.pinyin: Kǒngzǐ xīwàng jūnwáng nénggòu jiēshòu tā de jiànyì lái guǎnlǐ guójiā.
examples.english: Confucius hoped that the king could accept his advice to govern the country.

examples.chinese: 在德國舉辦的歐洲足球比賽，一共有十二個國家報名。
examples.pinyin: Zài Déguó jǔbàn de Ōuzhōu zúqiú bǐsài, yígòng yǒu shí'èr ge guójiā bàomíng.
examples.english: For the European football match held in Germany, a total of twelve countries registered.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，成年的孩子常跟父母住在一起，還是滿十八歲就搬出去了？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, chéngnián de háizi cháng gēn fùmǔ zhù zài yīqǐ, háishì mǎn shíbā suì jiù bān chūqù le?
examples.english: In your country, do children who have become adults often live with their parents, or do they move out as soon as they turn eighteen?

examples.chinese: 臺灣是一個海島國家，周圍的海底有豐富的珍貴資源。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān shì yī gè hǎidǎo guójiā, zhōuwéi de hǎidǐ yǒu fēngfù de zhēnguì zīyuán.
examples.english: Taiwan is an island country; the seabed around it has rich and precious resources.

examples.chinese: 世界運動會的規模很大，每回舉辦時，五大洲的國家都會來參加。
examples.pinyin: Shìjiè Yùndònghuì de guīmó hěn dà, měi huí jǔbàn shí, wǔ dà zhōu de guójiā dōu huì lái cānjiā.
examples.english: The scale of the World Games is very large; each time it is held, countries from five continents come to participate.

examples.chinese: 那場強烈地震發生以後，許多國家的專業人員都來救災，讓人非常感動。
examples.pinyin: Nà chǎng qiángliè dìzhèn fāshēng yǐhòu, xǔduō guójiā de zhuānyè rényuán dōu lái jiùzāi, ràng rén fēicháng gǎndòng.
examples.english: After that strong earthquake occurred, professionals from many countries came to provide disaster relief, which was very moving.

examples.chinese: 小周才三十歲，就去過四十幾個國家，甚至去過一些又危險又刺激的地方，真是太酷了！
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhōu cái sānshí suì, jiù qùguò sìshí jǐ gè guójiā, shènzhì qùguò yīxiē yòu wēixiǎn yòu cìjī de dìfāng, zhēn shì tài kù le!
examples.english: Xiao Zhou is only thirty years old, but has already been to over forty countries, and even some dangerous and exciting places—that's really so cool!

examples.chinese: 臺灣護照比以前好用得多，去許多國家旅行都不需要簽證了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān hùzhào bǐ yǐqián hǎoyòng de duō, qù xǔduō guójiā lǚxíng dōu bù xūyào qiānzhèng le.
examples.english: A Taiwan passport is much more useful than before; when traveling to many countries, you don't need a visa anymore.

examples.chinese: 這個紀念堂是為了紀念那些為國家犧牲生命的軍人。
examples.pinyin: Zhège jìniàntáng shì wèile jìniàn nàxiē wèi guójiā xīshēng shēngmìng de jūnrén.
examples.english: This memorial hall is to commemorate those soldiers who sacrificed their lives for the country.

examples.chinese: 這個國家公園的服務中心提供遊客簡介，介紹公園的特色和有名的景點。
examples.pinyin: Zhège guójiā gōngyuán de fúwù zhōngxīn tígōng yóukè jiǎnjiè, jièshào gōngyuán de tèsè hé yǒumíng de jǐngdiǎn.
examples.english: This national park's service center provides visitors with a brief introduction, introducing the park's features and famous scenic spots.

examples.chinese: 打仗期間，許多軍人為國家犧牲了寶貴的生命，也給家人留下了痛苦的記憶。
examples.pinyin: Dǎzhàng qījiān, xǔduō jūnrén wèi guójiā xīshēngle bǎoguì de shēngmìng, yě gěi jiārén liúxiàle tòngkǔ de jìyì.
examples.english: During the war, many soldiers sacrificed their precious lives for the country, and also left painful memories for their families.

examples.chinese: 在你的國家，第一次辦理護照得本人親自去，不能請別人代替嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zài nǐ de guójiā, dì-yī cì bànlǐ hùzhào děi běnrén qīnzì qù, bùnéng qǐng biérén dàitì ma?
examples.english: In your country, the first time you apply for a passport, do you have to go in person yourself, and cannot ask someone else to do it for you?

examples.chinese: 這兩個國家因為搶石油資源，而把對方當成了敵人。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng ge guójiā yīnwèi qiǎng shíyóu zīyuán, ér bǎ duìfāng dāngchéng le dírén.
examples.english: These two countries, because they are fighting over oil resources, have regarded each other as enemies.

examples.chinese: 「總統」是國家最高領導人，他領導全國民眾往前走，讓國家越來越進步。
examples.pinyin: 「Zǒngtǒng」 shì guójiā zuìgāo lǐngdǎorén, tā lǐngdǎo quánguó mínzhòng wǎng qián zǒu, ràng guójiā yuè lái yuè jìnbù.
examples.english: The "president" is the highest leader of the country; he leads the people of the whole nation forward, making the country more and more progressive.

examples.chinese: 總統對國家的貢獻很大，全國民眾都很尊敬他。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng duì guójiā de gòngxiàn hěn dà, quánguó mínzhòng dōu hěn zūnjìng tā.
examples.english: The president's contribution to the country is great; the people of the whole nation all respect him.

examples.chinese: 國家圖書館和博物館都是公共資源，任何人都可以使用。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā túshūguǎn hé bówùguǎn dōu shì gōnggòng zīyuán, rènhé rén dōu kěyǐ shǐyòng.
examples.english: National libraries and museums are public resources that anyone can use.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 《生日快樂》是全世界著名的歌曲，不同國家的人也能用自己的語言唱出來。
examples.pinyin: 《Shēngrì Kuàilè》 shì quán shìjiè zhùmíng de gēqǔ, bùtóng guójiā de rén yě néng yòng zìjǐ de yǔyán chàng chūlái.
examples.english: "Happy Birthday" is a world-famous song; people from different countries can also sing it in their own languages.

examples.chinese: 國家跟國家之間的外交關係很重要，這方面的工作是總統負責的。
examples.pinyin: Guójiā gēn guójiā zhījiān de wàijiāo guānxì hěn zhòngyào, zhè fāngmiàn de gōngzuò shì zǒngtǒng fùzé de.
examples.english: Diplomatic relations between countries are very important; work in this area is the president's responsibility.

examples.chinese: 從六○年代開始，臺灣就提供農業方面的協助給許多國家，這點讓我覺得很驕傲。
examples.pinyin: Cóng liù○ niándài kāishǐ, Táiwān jiù tígōng nóngyè fāngmiàn de xiézhù gěi xǔduō guójiā, zhè diǎn ràng wǒ juéde hěn jiāo'ào.
examples.english: Starting from the 1960s, Taiwan has provided assistance in agriculture to many countries; this point makes me feel very proud.

examples.chinese: 許多國家因為工業進步得太快，反而使得農業慢慢不被重視了。
examples.pinyin: Xǔduō guójiā yīnwèi gōngyè jìnbù de tài kuài, fǎn'ér shǐde nóngyè mànmàn bù bèi zhòngshì le.
examples.english: Because industry in many countries progressed too quickly, it instead made agriculture gradually not be valued.

examples.chinese: 每個國家打招呼的方式都不太一樣。
發展科技對國家來說很重要，不過也應該注意環保問題。
你在辦一些國家的簽證時，他們得看你的銀行存款。
送禮品給外國朋友前，最好先了解不同國家的送禮習慣。
我們國家出口的農產品很有名，不但價格低，品質又好。
部分國家規定，騎腳踏車時是不能載人的。
政府最主要的任務應是維持並保護社會安全，其次是規畫各種制度，使國家穩定地成長。
一個國家光是依靠免費簽證，是無法吸引國外遊客來旅行的。
有些國家為了吸引更多的觀光客來旅遊，就把一些出境、入境的手續改簡單了。
從小時候起，他的第一志願就是當一位保護國家的軍人。
假如失去了人民的信心與支持，國家也會變得不安定。
有些國家機場對攜帶物品的規定很嚴，出國前最好了解清楚。
有些國家的傳統戲劇常利用影子和燈光效果來表演。
為了人民的健康，許多國家都禁止進口受到環境汙染的農產品。
A:那所大學雖然相當著名，但我國政府不承認他們的學位(academic degree)。B:許多國家都承認那所大學的學位，貴國哪裡有不承認的道理？
對人民來說，最大的不幸就是國家機構腐敗。
就算沒有很高的學位，只要用心一樣能對國家社會有貢獻。
臺灣企業到發展中國家設立工廠，是因為當地的人工便宜。
在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
教育是國家的根本，能改變國家的未來。
每面國旗都代表一個國家，而且設計上都具有獨特的意義。
戰爭雖然勝利了，這個國家卻也失去了許多寶貴的生命。
看到自己國家的國旗進入奧運會場，民眾也不斷揮著手上的小旗子，替自己的國家加油。
這項新發明解決了許多環保問題，發明的人還受國家表揚。

items.wordHook: 國(country) + 家(home) → a nation is a country that feels like home.

examples.chinese: 那位教授的教法很好，很多學生都想修他的課。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu de jiàofǎ hěn hǎo, hěn duō xuéshēng dōu xiǎng xiū tā de kè.
examples.english: That professor's teaching method is very good; many students want to take his course.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 很多外國學生弄不清楚漢字的聲調。
examples.pinyin: Hěnduō wàiguó xuéshēng nòng bù qīngchǔ Hànzì de shēngdiào.
examples.english: Many foreign students cannot get the tones of Chinese characters clear.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: 有的日本學生覺得寫漢字不難，可是漢語的聲調很難。
examples.pinyin: Yǒude Rìběn xuéshēng juéde xiě Hànzì bù nán, kěshì Hànyǔ de shēngdiào hěn nán.
examples.english: Some Japanese students feel that writing Chinese characters is not hard, but the tones of Mandarin are very hard.

examples.chinese: (1) 不少外國人說中文不容易學，除了漢字難寫，聲調、語法也很難。想把中文學好，總而言之就是多聽、多說、多練習。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo wàiguórén shuō Zhōngwén bù róngyì xué, chúle Hànzì nán xiě, shēngdiào, yǔfǎ yě hěn nán. Xiǎng bǎ Zhōngwén xué hǎo, zǒng'éryánzhī jiùshì duō tīng, duō shuō, duō liànxí.
examples.english: Many foreigners say Chinese is not easy to learn; besides Chinese characters being hard to write, tones and grammar are also difficult. To learn Chinese well, in short, it is about listening more, speaking more, and practicing more.

examples.chinese: 那三家商店都賣相同牌子的皮包，我們最好先比個價，再決定買哪一家的。
examples.pinyin: Nà sān jiā shāngdiàn dōu mài xiāngtóng páizi de píbāo, wǒmen zuìhǎo xiān bǐ ge jià, zài juédìng mǎi nǎ yì jiā de.
examples.english: Those three stores all sell handbags of the same brand; we'd better compare prices first, then decide which one to buy from.

examples.chinese: 越來越多人選擇上網購物，有的是為了節省時間，有的是因為比價很方便。
examples.pinyin: Yuè lái yuè duō rén xuǎnzé shàngwǎng gòuwù, yǒude shì wèile jiéshěng shíjiān, yǒude shì yīnwèi bǐjià hěn fāngbiàn.
examples.english: More and more people choose to shop online; some do so to save time, and some because comparing prices is very convenient.

examples.chinese: 購物時，最好要貨比三家，才能買到品質較佳、價格較合理的商品。
examples.pinyin: Gòuwù shí, zuìhǎo yào huò bǐ sān jiā, cái néng mǎi dào pǐnzhì jiào jiā, jiàgé jiào hélǐ de shāngpǐn.
examples.english: When shopping, it is best to compare goods at three stores; only then can you buy products with relatively better quality and relatively more reasonable prices.

items.wordHook: Combining 比(compare) and 價(price): 比價 means compare prices.
Repeating 公(public) twice for emphasis: 公公 means father-in-law.

examples.chinese: 白小姐平時對穿著不怎麼講究，衣服穿來穿去總是那幾件。
examples.pinyin: Bái xiǎojiě píngshí duì chuānzhuó bù zěnme jiǎngjiu, yīfu chuān lái chuān qù zǒngshì nà jǐ jiàn.
examples.english: Miss Bai doesn't pay much attention to clothing in normal times; the clothes she wears are always just those few pieces.

examples.chinese: 想把菜園照顧好，平時就得多用心，看到蟲子就得處理。
人人都希望自己的孩子有幸福的生活、美好的未來。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xīwàng zìjǐ de háizi yǒu xìngfú de shēnghuó, měihǎo de wèilái.
examples.english: Everyone hopes their children will have a happy life and a beautiful future.

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 人人都喜歡薪水高、離家近、輕鬆的工作，不過這往往只是一個夢。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu xǐhuan xīnshuǐ gāo, lí jiā jìn, qīngsōng de gōngzuò, búguò zhè wǎngwǎng zhǐshì yí ge mèng.
examples.english: Everyone likes a job with a high salary, close to home, and easy, but this is often just a dream.

examples.chinese: 飲食與健康有密切的關係，所以人人都應該按時吃三餐。
examples.pinyin: Yǐnshí yǔ jiànkāng yǒu mìqiè de guānxì, suǒyǐ rénrén dōu yīnggāi ànshí chī sān cān.
examples.english: Diet and health have a close relationship, so everyone should eat three meals on time.

examples.chinese: 在雲端科技發達的時代裡，人人都能夠透過網路交友、學習。
examples.pinyin: Zài yúnduān kējì fādá de shídài lǐ, rénrén dōu nénggòu tòuguò wǎnglù jiāoyǒu, xuéxí.
examples.english: In an era of advanced cloud technology, everyone can make friends and learn through the internet.

examples.chinese: 人人都有屬於自己的長處，要對自己更有信心。
人人都崇拜明星，但有多少人了解成功背後所付出的一切？
假如人人都發揮人性美好的一面，就能給社會帶來和平。

items.wordHook: Repeating 人(person) twice for emphasis: 人人 means everyone.

examples.chinese: 總統處理任何問題時，最先想到的應該是國家的利益，不是個人的利益。
examples.pinyin: Zǒngtǒng chǔlǐ rènhé wèntí shí, zuì xiān xiǎngdào de yīnggāi shì guójiā de lìyì, bú shì gèrén de lìyì.
examples.english: When the president handles any issue, what he should think of first is the nation's interests, not personal interests.

examples.chinese: 博物館裡的東西非常寶貴， 它們具有民族和文化的價值， 沒辦法用錢算清楚的。每個人的生命價值都是一樣的，不應該為了自己的利益而犧牲別人。
examples.pinyin: 1. Bówùguǎn lǐ de dōngxi fēicháng bǎoguì, tāmen jùyǒu mínzú hé wénhuà de jiàzhí, méi bànfǎ yòng qián suàn qīngchu de. 2. Měi gè rén de shēngmìng jiàzhí dōu shì yīyàng de, bù yīnggāi wèile zìjǐ de lìyì ér xīshēng biérén.
examples.english: 1. The things in the museum are very precious; they have ethnic and cultural value and cannot be calculated clearly with money. 2. Everyone's value of life is the same; one should not sacrifice others for one's own interests.

items.wordHook: Combining 利(gains) and 益(profit): 利益 means interest, benefit, advantage.

examples.chinese: 根據專家的說法，想要身體健康，一天至少得喝五大杯水。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù zhuānjiā de shuōfǎ, xiǎng yào shēntǐ jiànkāng, yì tiān zhìshǎo děi hē wǔ dà bēi shuǐ.
examples.english: According to experts, if you want to be healthy, you need to drink at least five large glasses of water a day.

examples.chinese: 這所學校規定學生每兩週至少參加一次服務學習活動。
如果想捐頭髮，長度至少要十五公分以上才能捐。

items.wordHook: Combining 至(reach) and 少(few): 至少 means at least.

examples.chinese: 他有一點兒膽小，又容易緊張，我看這件事你先別告訴他。
張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
我姑姑跟姑丈結婚已經有二十年了，感情一直很好。
我姑姑的房間裡有淡淡的玫瑰花味兒，那種氣味真香。
這種巧克力是情人節最熱門的商品，總是一下子就賣光了。
電視臺常在熱門比賽的轉播中放一些廣告，靠這種方式來賺錢。
聽說那場演唱會很熱門，我們最好先預訂門票。
到外面做了丟人的事，自己和家人也會覺得丟臉。
經過兩段不幸的感情生活，那位女士對愛情已失去了信心。
他順利當上那家大飯店的廚師後，好多朋友都打電話祝賀他。
小周找到理想工作後，女友特地送了一條領帶當作禮物，還親手為他打領帶，祝賀他有個好的開始。
我們公司因為業務需要，最近增加了不少人力。
奶油不但種類多，並且是做甜點時不能少的材料。
這塊玉的品質不錯，如果做成玉器應該可以賣出好價錢。
雕刻玉器的技術很複雜，目前多半還是只能靠人工處理。
奶奶養了幾隻雞，每天早上習慣抓兩把玉米餵牠們。
哥哥去超市買了一袋玉米和兩包麵條，要為家人準備晚餐。
examples.pinyin: Gēge qù chāoshì mǎi le yí dài yùmǐ hé liǎng bāo miàntiáo, yào wèi jiārén zhǔnbèi wǎncān.
examples.english: My older brother went to the supermarket and bought a bag of corn and two packs of noodles, to prepare dinner for the family.

items.wordHook: The royal 王(king) scepter set with a gleaming 丶(dot) at its base is crafted from precious 玉(jade).
Combining 以(according to) and 外(out): 以外 means apart from, except for.
a 亻(person) stands with 更(more) time to spare → oh so 便(convenient).
最(most) + 近(near) → the most near time is 'recently'.
Combining 博(wide) and 士(scholar): 博士 means doctor, PhD.
a 宀(roof) covers a 佰(hundred) beds for travelers → a place to 宿(stop).
Asking 怎(how) with particle 麼(particle) in this 一(one) turn 回(return) of the 事(affair): 怎麼一回事 means what's the matter.
Combining 文(culture) and 學(learn): 文學 means literature.
Combining 明(bright) and 星(star): 明星 means star movie or television.
紅(red) + 茶(tea) → red tea, the Chinese name for black tea, from its red-colored brew.
Poetic lines of rhythmic 言(speech) harmonized with the melody of 周(zhōu) create a 調(tune).
Combining 鬧(busy) and 鐘(bell): 鬧鐘 means alarm clock.
